Cerebrovascular disease = brain injury due to altered blood flow; grouped into ischemic and hemorrhagic etiologies — tissue infarction is the ultimate consequence of both.

SARS-CoV-2 causes a variety of neurological sequelae in COVID-19 survivors, including dizziness, headache, myalgias, hypogeusia, hyposmia, polyneuropathy, myositis, cerebrovascular diseases, encephalitis, and encephalopathy.

Low-dose aspirin can decrease uric acid excretion and trigger recurrent gout flares but it should not be stopped in patients taking it for specific indications (e.g., coronary artery disease, cerebrovascular disease), regardless of the severity of gout.
